notes.title: Click to add pixels to crafting
notes.content: - Included the option to disable drag and drop for crafting, allowing individual pixels to be selected by clicking.

notes.title: Customization Update
notes.content:
This update adds the following new features:

Quick crafting:
There is now an option to enable quick-crafting, which allows you to select pixels to craft with a single click. However, you will not be able to pick specific pixels to craft.

Pixel Gallery Sorting:
You can now sort the pixels in the pixel gallery by colour and rarity.

Background Colour:
You can now set the background colour to the colour of an owned pixel by double-clicking an owned pixel in the gallery.

Pixel Canvas:
You can now place owned pixels in the background by enabling canvas mode, In canvas mode, click on a pixel in the gallery to select it, left click on the background to place a pixel, and right click to remove a pixel. Press 'H' to hide the UI.

notes.title: Compatibility patch
notes.content: - This update should make the game compatible with a wider variety of devices.

notes.title: Quantity bugfix
notes.content: - Fixed a bug where pixel quantities and individual pixels in the crafting menu did not show up correctly for pixels bought from the community market in large quantities

notes.title: Individual pixels update
notes.content:
- Reworked the pixel crafting page. Now you can inspect individual pixels in your inventory, and see how you got each pixel (drop, crafting, market, trade), and also when you got it.
- You can now pick individual pixels to consume when crafting.
- Moved volume and background options to an options menu. Also added fullscreen/borderless options.
- Added a clicks counter.

notes.title: Steam cloud saves
notes.content:
- Changed the way score is saved and enable steam cloud saves so score is tied to Steam account and persists even if players use multiple devices
- Minor bugfixes

notes.title: Score (Literally Just A Number On A Screen) Update
notes.content:
- Added a Score (Literally Just A Number On A Screen) that increases based on time spent in game and rarity of unique pixels owned
- Small performance optimization to slightly reduce RAM usage

notes.title: Dark Mode Update
notes.content:
- Added Dark Mode to protect players' eyesight
- Fixed a bug where sometimes the list of pixels in the pixel crafting screen wouldn't populate if the game is closed and re-opened between pixel drops

notes.title: Small QOL update
notes.content:
- Added countdown timer for next pixel drop (the timer won't work properly until after your next pixel drop) 
- Lowered default volume
